svg.title: Surface-wind sample: forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Oct 8, 2026 to Oct 29, 2026
svg.desc: Histograms of forecast minus reported wind speed, gust and direction for Open-Meteo's hourly, 15-minute and current 10 m wind and the NWS hour, each KPMV report once. The dashed line is zero. Bars right of zero are blue (forecast above the report), left of it magenta (below), the zero bar grey (nearer zero than half a bin, on neither side).
svg.text: Surface-wind sample: forecasts minus KPMV's reports, Oct 8, 2026 to Oct 29, 2026
Reports per bin. Right of the dashed line the forecast was above the report, left of it below.
Each forecast as it stood while the report was the newest. Rows: Open-Meteo’s three forms, then NWS on the same reports.
forecast above the report (right of the line)
nearer zero than half a bin (neither)

Open-Meteo rows: weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0), reworked as differences from KPMV’s reports.

Every row to a tenth of a knot, binned to the knot; a tenth either side of zero counts on neither side. Direction only where the report gave one. Source: docs/surface-wind-sources.md, scripts/windErrorsData.ts.
